rules.title: Anti-Eviction Act: no rent increase to cover condominium/cooperative conversion costs
rules.requirement: When a building is converted to a condominium, cooperative or fee simple ownership of units, landlords may not raise rents to cover costs resulting solely from the conversion. Rents may still be raised to cover the cost of new services or amenities.

requires.name: building_conversion
requires.text: a building is converted to a condominium or cooperative form of ownership, or to fee simple ownership of units

coverage.summary: Applies to converted buildings and to all tenants in them, whether or not they are protected senior or disabled tenants.

rules.quoted_span: If a building is converted to a condominium or cooperative form of ownership, or to fee simple ownership of units, rents may not be increased to cover cos ts resulting solely from the conversion (N.J.S.A. 2A:18-61.31).
